title: Marcos signs bill postponing barangay elections to 2028

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has signed a law that sets the term of barangay officials to 5 years and postpones this year’s barangay and sangguniang kabataan elections (BSKE) to November 2028, the Palace confirmed Friday.
